items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: John Parker. Yes, I know him.

ctx.x: I've seen his picture. He's playing off the horn right there.

That's right. He's dead now. And of course he used to play clarinet. He was a good musician. He used to be a director. He's almost like Chalini. I guess you were talking about Chalini. Of course I'm talking about them old timers like this fella here. Well, that's old time too. John Parker. Yes, I know him. John Parker? Willie. Willie Popper. Live off St. Philip's straight there. Well, I know him. Well, of course I can't mention the young fellas these days in time because they're coming up like they come from…
You're still working when you run to work. You're still working with the Gibson band anyway.
